tools.name: prepare_credential_use
tools.title: Prepare an action using a local credential
tools.description: Prepare a one-use opaque handle for an owner-authorised authentication action. Never returns the secret.

tools.name: use_credential
tools.title: Use a local credential without revealing it
tools.description: Ask the trusted local executor to perform the pre-bound action. The model cannot choose another origin or receive passwords, cookies or tokens.

scope: domain-only; local transport is implemented separately by runtime-tools.mjs and mcp-server.mjs
